core_obligations: Existence (proof lines 2279-2295): functoriality of the plus construction gives a commutative diagram relating the plus constructions of the presheaf and of the sheaf, and the lower horizontal maps are isomorphisms because the plus construction applied to a sheaf is an isomorphism; this produces the required factorisation.
Uniqueness (proof lines 2296-2298): since every section of the sheafification locally comes from a section of the presheaf, two factorisations agree locally and hence are equal.
proof_roadmap: Compare the plus constructions of the presheaf and of the sheaf.
Use that the plus construction is an isomorphism on sheaves to get the factorisation.
Use the local description of sections of the sheafification for uniqueness.
difficulty_reason: The proposition establishes the universal property of the canonical map to the sheafification: any map from the presheaf to a sheaf factors uniquely through it (statement lines 2269-2276). The proof is short and complete: functoriality of the plus construction gives a commutative diagram whose lower horizontal maps are isomorphisms because the plus construction is an isomorphism on sheaves, which yields the factorisation (proof lines 2279-2295); and uniqueness follows because sections of the sheafification are locally sections of the presheaf (proof lines 2296-2298). The non-formal content is the diagram comparison. The claim is H1: two short steps with each input named.
